items.claim: SceneNode schema empty because the node types now sit in `nodeTypes.ts` and `types.ts` only re-exports them
Inspector's op catalog reads a fixed seven files and misses most of core's op factories
An args type written as a type alias always gives an empty params list
items.note: Latent, since no op used an alias. extract-node's duplicate member reader now goes through the same shared helper.

items.claim: Action catalog shows only undo and redo, missing `defineAction`/factory actions and editing's actions
items.note: It now lists 60. Actions whose id is computed from a factory argument (`makeAlignAction('left')`, nudge, pathfinder) still appear under their export name, because their id isn't in the source as a literal.

items.claim: Gesture catalog has a nonexistent `pointerdown` kind and lacks six real ones; the hand-written `drag` payload was wrong
items.note: Each entry is now built from the `GestureSpec` union and lists that kind's spec fields. The inspector's `GESTURE_CATALOG_KEYS` is checked against the union by `satisfies Record<GestureSpec['kind'], true>`.

items.claim: Shape extractor walks `makeLeaf`, which is gone, so every shape came out empty, polygon/star listed a callback as data, and lasso appeared as a shape
items.note: It now reads `KIT_INSERT_KINDS` and the node each `case '<kind>':` in editing's `deps/insert.ts` builds. pen and lasso now correctly show no schema.

items.claim: `watchedFilesFor` lists two deleted files and misses the files the extractors read
items.note: The list is now built from each extractor's own exported source constants and matches directories. It also refreshes on files added or removed, not only changed. A test checks that every schema's source file is watched.

items.claim: Callback-source plugin misses editing's and routing's tools and actions; the prefix test lets `tools` match `toolsX`
items.note: Tools and actions live in more than a dozen packages, so it now includes every package's `src`, and it matches by directory.

items.claim: `draw:rotation`'s arrowhead points down while the arc arrives moving right
16 of draw's glyphs are named nowhere, four of them duplicating core's text-styling glyphs
items.note: This is my call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md` under "draw". The 16 are deleted, and a test fails on any draw glyph draw's source doesn't name. I fixed rotation in the commit before, so reverting the deletion brings back a correct glyph.
